_about: Apollodorus in English: Sir James George Frazer's translation of the Library (Loeb, 1921, 2 vols.), from Perseus TEI (section "perseus", fetched by pipeline/fetch_perseus.py); the file carries Frazer's notes and appendices with the translation.
